New Research Reveals Overcoming Legacy Tech Issues Key to AI Success
recent_posts.summary: IDC research commissioned by MongoDB surveyed 1,400 Asia/Pacific organizations and found that legacy infrastructure and data debt are the primary barriers to AI success. Organizations that continuously modernize their tech stack generate 3x more digital revenue than peers still burdened by technical debt. Key findings: 43% cite existing architecture as a major obstacle, CIOs who ignore data debt face 50% higher AI failure rates by 2027, and 38% of APAC organizations prioritize cloud-centric data management in 2026. Leaders differentiate by treating modernization as an ongoing operating model across people, process, and technology rather than a one-off project.

recent_posts.title: MongoDB Predictive Auto-Scaling: An Experiment
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB's engineering team describes a 2023 research experiment that led to the production rollout of predictive auto-scaling in MongoDB Atlas. The prototype used three components: a Long-Term Forecaster (MSTL decomposition for seasonal/trend patterns), a Short-Term Forecaster (trend interpolation for non-seasonal workloads), and an Estimator (boosted decision tree regression trained on 25 million samples) to predict CPU utilization across instance tiers. A Planner then selects the cheapest instance size to handle forecasted demand. The experiment showed the predictive scaler would have saved an average of 9 cents per hour per replica set versus the reactive scaler. The production version, rolled out in November 2025, conservatively scales replica sets up before predicted load spikes while relying on the existing reactive algorithm to scale down afterward.

recent_posts.title: Introducing MongoDB Agent Skills and Plugins for Coding Agents
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB is launching official Agent Skills and plugins for AI coding tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code. Agent Skills are structured instructions and best practices that guide coding agents to avoid common MongoDB pitfalls like over-normalizing schemas, underusing compound indexes, and misusing search indexes. The skills are packaged alongside the MongoDB MCP Server into ready-to-use plugins, enabling teams to embed MongoDB expertise directly into their agentic workflows. Installation is straightforward via a single CLI command or plugin install, and developers can also build custom skills to codify internal conventions.

recent_posts.title: Enhance Your in-IDE Data Browsing Experience With MongoDB
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB has released a major update to its VS Code extension, now generally available, featuring an enhanced in-IDE data browsing experience. Key additions include a paginated tree view with prescriptive document titles (auto-detecting human-readable fields instead of showing raw _id hashes), contextual action menus for inserting, deleting, cloning, and editing documents without writing queries, and a default Shell syntax mode that eliminates the need to translate commands to EJSON. The goal is to reduce context switching by giving developers a full data management suite directly in their editor sidebar.

recent_posts.title: Observability and OpenTelemetry: Introducing MongoDB Atlas Log Integration
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB Atlas now supports direct log integration with third-party observability and storage platforms. Teams can stream mongod, mongos, and audit logs to Datadog, Splunk, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, Amazon S3, or any OpenTelemetry-compatible endpoint. The feature targets M10+ dedicated clusters and can be configured in minutes via the Atlas UI or Terraform. Key benefits include accelerated incident troubleshooting, unified telemetry correlation across logs and metrics, and simplified compliance through automated audit log routing to long-term storage.

recent_posts.title: Inside MongoDB's Dublin office and what it's like to work there
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB's Dublin office serves as the company's international headquarters, housing over 300 employees from more than 40 nationalities. Established in 2012, the office has grown into a core engineering and sales hub for EMEA. Employees share experiences across product engineering (including query optimization and database internals), sales, and technical services, highlighting the collaborative culture, career growth opportunities, and benefits like 27 days annual leave, 20 weeks parental leave, and wellness programs. The office is actively hiring across technical and commercial roles.

recent_posts.title: Towards Model-based Verification of a Key-Value Storage Engine
recent_posts.summary: MongoDB engineers describe a model-based verification approach for checking conformance between the WiredTiger key-value storage engine and a formal TLA+ specification of its API. Using a modified TLC model checker, they generate the complete reachable state graph of the storage component specification, then compute path coverings to produce individual test cases as sequences of WiredTiger API calls. For a small finite model (2 keys, 2 transactions), this yields 87,143 automatically generated tests executed in ~40 minutes. The work is part of a broader compositional verification effort for MongoDB's distributed transactions protocol, published at VLDB '25, and future directions include broader WiredTiger API coverage, randomized state space exploration, and potential LLM-assisted model generation.

recent_posts.title: Building a Movie Recommendation Engine with Hugging Face and Voyage AI
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to building a mood-based movie recommendation engine using voyage-4-nano embeddings, Hugging Face datasets, and MongoDB Atlas Vector Search. The tutorial covers setting up a local MongoDB Atlas deployment, generating text embeddings with Sentence Transformers, indexing 500 movies with plot embeddings, and exposing a FastAPI search endpoint that accepts natural language mood descriptions. It also explores how Matryoshka embedding dimensions (256, 512, 1024, 2048) affect retrieval quality and latency trade-offs, with concrete similarity score comparisons.

recent_posts.title: Vision RAG: Enabling Search on Any Documents
recent_posts.summary: Vision RAG extends traditional retrieval-augmented generation to handle multimodal documents by using multimodal embeddings instead of OCR. Voyage AI's voyage-multimodal-3 model uses a unified encoder architecture to process both text and images, enabling direct indexing and search of complex documents like PDFs, slides, and diagrams. The tutorial demonstrates building a vision RAG pipeline that extracts insights from GitHub Octoverse charts by embedding images with Voyage AI, performing vector similarity search, and generating answers using Anthropic's Claude vision model.
